in_marathi.name: Ajaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajaya is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'aj' meaning 'not' and 'jay' meaning 'victory'. It is a masculine name that signifies invincibility, unconquerability, and the power to overcome all obstacles.
